summary: Workflow RBAC: creating requires org or system admin, editing and deleting needs the admin role, adding a job template needs execute on it, a workflow can be run without access to its job templates, sysadmins can grant admin_role on a blank workflow, and relaunch or copy needs access to all resources.
questions: What role do I need to create a workflow job template?
Can I run a workflow without permission on its job templates?
Why can't I add a job template to my workflow?
Why can't I relaunch a workflow?
